name: Drawdown Plan
tagline: Turn a nest egg into a paycheck that lasts
about: Drawdown Plan is for the last five years before retirement and the first ten after: withdrawal rates that fit your horizon, bucket strategies, sequence-risk protection and a year-one income schedule you can actually follow.
persona: You are a decumulation specialist: measured, safety-first, fluent in withdrawal rules and bucket strategies, general about tax, and clear that an adviser should check the final plan.

onboarding.title: Make it last
onboarding.subtitle: Tell us the size of the pot and what it needs to cover.

tools.title: Pick my withdrawal rate
tools.subtitle: How much can the pot pay?

inputs.label: Can you cut spending in bad years?

tools.prompt: Profile pot and guaranteed income, spending {spend}/year for {horizon} years, flexibility: {flex}. kv (needed from portfolio per year, implied withdrawal rate, verdict, suggested starting rate). Table (Rule | How it works | Starting income | Best when) for fixed percentage, inflation-adjusted, guardrails, and floor-and-upside. Bullets on what pushes a safe rate up or down, and a callout on sequence-of-returns risk.

tools.title: Build my buckets
tools.subtitle: Cash, income, growth
tools.prompt: Design a {style} strategy for the profile pot withdrawing {spend}/year. Table (Bucket | Purpose | Years covered | Amount | Asset types), steps to set it up, kv of refill rules (when → from which bucket), and a callout on the classic mistake of never refilling the cash bucket.

tools.title: Year-one paycheck
tools.subtitle: A monthly income schedule
tools.prompt: Build a year-one income schedule for the profile paying {monthly}/month, with other income timing: {dates}. Table (Month | From guaranteed | From portfolio | From cash | Notes), steps for setting up automatic transfers, a checklist of accounts and paperwork, and a callout on keeping 12–24 months of withdrawals in cash.

tools.title: Protect against a crash
tools.subtitle: Sequence risk, defended
tools.prompt: The user retires in {years} years with the profile pot. Explain sequence-of-returns risk in text with a two-retiree numeric example, then a table (Defence | What it does | Cost | Set up by when) for cash buffer, bond tent, flexible spending, delaying, part-time income; steps to implement over the next {years} years; and a callout on what not to do in a crash.

tools.title: Annual check-up
tools.subtitle: Raise, hold or cut?
tools.prompt: Annual review: pot now {value}, withdrew {withdrew}, market {market}. kv (current withdrawal rate, change vs the starting rate, guardrail status: raise / hold / cut), bullets of adjustments for the coming year, a checklist of housekeeping (rebalance, refill buckets, review fees, beneficiaries), and a callout with the one number to watch.

disclaimer: General education only — not financial, tax or legal advice. Figures are illustrative projections, not predictions; check your own situation with a licensed adviser.
